name: ptbo-feedback-checks
description: Development-only Firebase emulator and browser verification tools

scripts.test:rules: cd ../.. && NODE_PATH=tools/feedback-tests/node_modules tools/feedback-tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --config feedback/firebase.json --project demo-ptbo-feedback --only auth,firestore 'node --test feedback/tests/rules.test.cjs'
scripts.test:browser: cd ../.. && NODE_PATH=tools/feedback-tests/node_modules tools/feedback-tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --config feedback/firebase.json --project demo-ptbo-feedback --only auth,firestore 'node tests/feedback-browser.cjs'
